entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A Joraga Zendikari elf and animist, a former planeswalker and former Gatewatch member who wields magic to muster elves and elementals.

entities.name: Phyrexian Nissa Revane
entities.description: The compleated version of Nissa, partly replaced with copper root and bramble, who steered the Invasion Tree for the Phyrexians until she was un-compleated.

entities.name: Echoverse Nissa Revane
entities.description: An alternate Nissa of the Echoverse, a wizard leyline tamer who led an elven rebellion against the kor.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: The oath-bound group of Planeswalkers formed on Zendikar.

entities.name: Joraga
entities.description: The Zendikari elf tribe Nissa was born into, led by a council.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: Nissa's home plane, whose soul speaks to her.

entities.name: Bala Ged
entities.description: The continent of Zendikar where Nissa's home jungles lie, later devastated by Ulamog.

entities.name: Akoum
entities.description: A region of Zendikar where the Eye of Ugin lies.

entities.name: Meroe
entities.description: Nissa's mother, one of the last animists.

entities.name: Numa
entities.description: The Joraga chief who sent Nissa and her mother away.

entities.name: Mazik
entities.description: Nissa's friend who tracked her after she fled.

entities.name: Lorwyn
entities.description: A plane Nissa visited where the Great Aurora changed it to Shadowmoor.

entities.name: Shadowmoor
entities.description: The dark version of Lorwyn after the Great Aurora.

entities.name: Sutina
entities.description: A Tajuru Speaker who appointed Nissa a Captain Leaftalker and was killed by the Eldrazi brood.

entities.name: Tajuru
entities.description: Elves of the Turntimber of Ondu with whom Nissa studied.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: A vampire planeswalker who arrived to save Nissa and demanded to be taken to the Eye of Ugin.

entities.name: Anowon
entities.description: A vampiric Ruin Sage freed by Sorin who travelled with Nissa.

entities.name: Khalled
entities.description: A merfolk friend of Nissa at Graypelt Refuge.

entities.name: Smara
entities.description: A Kor woman said to be a witch vessel for a spirit in a crystal.

entities.name: Mudheel
entities.description: A goblin who agreed to lead the group to the Eye of Ugin.

entities.name: Brinelin
entities.description: The Moon Kraken who ruled the waters off Akoum and was friends with Sutina.

entities.name: Eye of Ugin
entities.description: The place on Akoum where the Eldrazi titans were imprisoned.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: The brood and titans that Nissa unleashed on Zendikar.

entities.name: Ulamog
entities.description: An Eldrazi Titan whose brood attacked the Joraga and who was trapped and destroyed.

entities.name: Kozilek
entities.description: An Eldrazi Titan coaxed out by Ob Nixilis and later destroyed.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: An Eldrazi Titan sealed inside Innistrad's moon.

entities.name: Hamadi
entities.description: A Graypelt member who found and helped Nissa recover.

entities.name: Ashaya
entities.description: An elemental companion of Nissa, known as the Awoken World.

entities.name: Ob Nixilis
entities.description: A demon and former planeswalker who sought the Khalni Heart to reignite his spark.

entities.name: Khalni Heart
entities.description: A place of power on Bala Ged that Nissa used to reconnect to Zendikar.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A pyromancer Planeswalker, member of the Gatewatch and Nissa's lover.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A Planeswalker and Gatewatch member.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A mind-mage Planeswalker and Gatewatch member.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A necromancer Planeswalker who joined the Gatewatch.

entities.name: Kiora
entities.description: A Planeswalker who helped the Gatewatch against the Eldrazi on Zendikar.

entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: A Planeswalker who combined power with Nissa to seal Emrakul.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane where Nissa helped trap Emrakul.

entities.name: Thraben
entities.description: The city on Innistrad where the Battle of Thraben took place.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The city plane where the Gatewatch based itself and where Bolas invaded.

entities.name: Kaladesh
entities.description: Chandra's home plane, where the Gatewatch aided the Renegades.

entities.name: Dovin Baan
entities.description: A Vedalken who tried to hire the Gatewatch on Ravnica.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: The Head Judge of Ghirapur and Bolas's servant.

entities.name: Pia Nalaar
entities.description: Chandra's mother, known as Renegade Prime.

entities.name: Baral
entities.description: A Consulate officer who trapped Chandra and Nissa.

entities.name: Oviya Pashiri
entities.description: A lifecrafter and friend of the Nalaars.

entities.name: Yahenni
entities.description: An Aetherborn whose parties helped Nissa and who died during the Aether Revolt.

entities.name: Ajani
entities.description: A leonin planeswalker who freed Nissa and Chandra from the Deadlock Trap.

entities.name: Ghirapur
entities.description: The city on Kaladesh.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: A plane under a curse where Bolas had built an army of Eternals.

entities.name: Kefnet
entities.description: An Amonkhet god whose trial Nissa entered.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The Elder Dragon who controlled Amonkhet's leylines and invaded Ravnica.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane where Nissa confronted Liliana.

entities.name: Belzenlok
entities.description: A demon to whom Liliana was indebted.

entities.name: Immortal Sun
entities.description: The artifact Bolas used to trap Planeswalkers on Ravnica.

entities.name: Vitu-Ghazi
entities.description: The hometree and guildhall of the Selesnya Conclave, animated by Nissa.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: A dragon of the Izzet who was resurrected as the Living Guildpact.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: A Kor planeswalker lithomancer with whom Nissa clashed.

entities.name: Lithoform Core
entities.description: An artifact channeling Zendikar's power, an ancient piece of Zendikar's soul.

entities.name: Singing City
entities.description: A place on Zendikar destroyed in the clash over the Lithoform Core.

entities.name: Lukka
entities.description: A planeswalker who saved Nissa from a Phyrexian monstrosity and then compleated himself.

entities.name: Vorinclex
entities.description: A Phyrexian praetor Nissa dueled.

entities.name: Realmbreaker
entities.description: The Invasion Tree that the compleated Nissa was attuned to.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: A Phyrexian praetor who revealed Nissa's compleation.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A planeswalker who knocked Nissa out in the final fight.

entities.name: Seven
entities.description: A member of the rebel team torn apart by compleated Nissa.

entities.name: Wrenn
entities.description: A planeswalker who arrived with Chandra to attack Realmbreaker.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A planeswalker who helped restore Nissa's body.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A planeswalker who helped restore Nissa's body.

entities.name: Melira
entities.description: A Mirran who helped restore Nissa's body.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: The Phyrexian plane.

entities.name: Zhalfir
entities.description: The plane to which Nissa was brought for healing.

entities.name: Great Desparkening
entities.description: The consequence of the New Phyrexian Invasion in which many Planeswalkers lost their sparks.

entities.name: Stem Sword
entities.description: A concealed sword hidden in Nissa's staff that later became Bitterthorn.

events.summary: Joraga chief Numa decides to send the animists away.
events.quote: Numa was adamant about sending them away because of the danger to the tribe.

events.summary: Believing Numa right, Nissa slips out of her home before her mother can notice.
events.quote: Nissa packed her staff-sword and bow and slipped out of the house before her mother could notice.

events.summary: Confronting the horror in the central peak of Akoum ignites Nissa's spark and she planeswalks away.
events.quote: the confrontation with the unspeakable horror ignited her spark

events.summary: On Lorwyn the Great Aurora changes the plane to Shadowmoor as Nissa confronts the elves who were killing boggarts.
events.quote: Just as she confronted the elves about this, the Great Aurora arrived and changed all of Lorwyn to Shadowmoor

events.summary: The Eldrazi brood attacks the Tajuru meeting and kills Sutina.
events.quote: the Eldrazi brood attacked the meeting and killed Sutina shortly after it began

events.summary: Sorin Markov arrives in time to save Nissa from the brood.
events.quote: Nissa would have fallen to the brood herself if not for the timely arrival of Sorin Markov

events.summary: Nissa wins over the Moon Kraken Brinelin by telling him of Sutina's death.
events.quote: Brinelin finally acquiesced to lead them safely through the crystal reefs.

events.summary: At the Eye of Ugin, Nissa shatters the main hedron and releases the Eldrazi titans.
events.quote: she shattered the main hedron and released the enchantment imprisoning the titans

events.summary: Nissa vows before the Joraga Council to find Sorin and bring him back to Zendikar.
events.quote: She told them of what had transpired and swore to find Sorin, to drag him back to Zendikar to help with the Eldrazi menace.

events.summary: Ulamog's brood attacks the Joraga and Nissa barely survives as their only survivor, saved by Hamadi's band.
events.quote: Nissa had barely survived, a band of humans saving her, apparently the only survivor of the Joraga tribe.

events.summary: An elemental that does not return to the land becomes Nissa's companion, Ashaya.
events.quote: It became her companion

events.summary: Nissa beats Ob Nixilis at the Khalni Heart and escapes with it and the revived Ashaya.
events.quote: Flush with the elemental power of Zendikar, Nissa bested Ob Nixilis, removed the Khalni Heart to safety, and escaped with the revived Ashaya.

events.summary: Jace activates the hedrons and traps Ulamog at Sea Gate.
events.quote: Jace then activated the hedron's magics and trapped Ulamog.

events.summary: Ob Nixilis reignites his spark with the hedron magic and escapes Zendikar.
events.quote: which reignited his planeswalker's spark and allowed him to escape from Zendikar

events.summary: Ob Nixilis coaxes Kozilek out from under the plane's crust.
events.quote: Ob Nixilis used his newfound power to coax the second Eldrazi Titan, Kozilek, from its hiding spot under the plane's crust.

events.summary: Chandra finds and frees Nissa, Jace and Gideon from Ob Nixilis's cave.
events.quote: Luckily, Chandra Nalaar had arrived on Zendikar, found the trio, and freed them.

events.summary: The four swear an oath to stand together, forming the Gatewatch.
events.quote: Thus they swore an oath to stand together and the formation of the Gatewatch was realized.

events.summary: Linked with Nissa, Chandra incinerates Ulamog and Kozilek.
events.quote: In one brilliant blaze of flame, Ulamog and Kozilek were incinerated and destroyed, leaving only ashes raining from Zendikar's sky.

events.summary: Nissa plants the seeds of Bala Ged's native plants.
events.quote: Nissa planted the seeds of Bala Ged that she had once received from the vampire straggler

events.summary: Nissa's sigil is branded on Innistrad's moon, trapping Emrakul inside.
events.quote: Nissa's sigil was branded on the moon, trapping Emrakul inside.

events.summary: Nissa berates Liliana for instigating Chandra's reckless behavior on Kaladesh.
events.quote: Nissa fled along with Liliana and Chandra and later berated Liliana for having instigated Chandra's reckless behavior.

events.summary: Baral traps Nissa, Chandra and Pashiri in an airtight Deadlock Trap.
events.quote: Baral lured the group into an airtight, enchanted Deadlock Trap

events.summary: Nissa soothes Chandra when Baral goads her to self-destruction.
events.quote: Nissa also came to support Chandra in her confrontation with Baral, who tried to goad her to self-destruction.

events.summary: In Kefnet's trial, Nissa learns to use blue mana.
events.quote: Within that trial, she learned not only to trust her instincts but also to utilize her thoughts, making her able to utilize blue mana.

events.summary: The Gatewatch is defeated by Bolas on Amonkhet; Nissa is saved by Gideon and flees.
events.quote: Nissa was mentally overwhelmed by Bolas after she found out that he controlled the leylines of the plane.

events.summary: Nissa renounces her oath and returns to Zendikar, leaving the Gatewatch.
events.quote: Nissa renounced her oath and returned to Zendikar, unwilling to lend further aid to the Gatewatch

events.summary: Nissa animates Vitu-Ghazi to tear down Bolas's statue; his God-Eternals then destroy the tree.
events.quote: She used it to tear down Bolas' statue, greatly boosting the morale of the Ravnican forces.

events.summary: Nissa rejoins the Gatewatch, renewing her vows.
events.quote: Nissa rejoined the Gatewatch at this meeting, renewing her vows.

events.summary: Nissa helps repair the leylines so Niv-Mizzet is resurrected as the Living Guildpact.
events.quote: they were able to resurrect Niv and grant him the power of the Living Guildpact

events.summary: After the war, Chandra and Nissa profess their love for each other.
events.quote: At that moment, Chandra and Nissa professed their love for each other.

events.summary: Nahiri's disregard for Zendikar's soul and her killing of an elemental friend turn Nissa against her.
events.quote: prompted the elf to turn against her

events.summary: Nissa destroys Nahiri's focal point in the Singing City with Ashaya and her elementals.
events.quote: Nissa had destroyed it with Ashaya and her other elementals

events.summary: Nissa uses the Lithoform Core, which levels the Singing City and then heals Zendikar.
events.quote: The Singing City was gone.

events.summary: Nissa realizes the Core has undone the damage and Zendikar is healing.
events.quote: It had undone the damage to the plane.

events.summary: A trap shunts Nissa away from New Phyrexia as soon as she arrives.
events.quote: However, as soon as she arrived on that plane, a trap shunted her away

events.summary: Lukka compleats himself and Nissa flees from him after dueling Vorinclex.
events.quote: Lukka had compleated himself and Nissa fled, hunted by the other planeswalker.

events.summary: Elesh Norn reveals that Nissa has been caught and compleated.
events.quote: Elesh Norn revealed that Nissa had been caught and compleated

events.summary: Compleated Nissa stops Chandra, Wrenn and Seven and tears Seven apart.
events.quote: it was Nissa who stopped them and tore Seven apart limb from limb

events.summary: Elspeth knocks Nissa out and Chandra brings her to Zhalfir.
events.quote: Nissa was knocked out by Elspeth and brought to Zhalfir by Chandra.

events.summary: Teferi, Karn and Melira restore Nissa's body and spark.
events.quote: Teferi, Karn, and Melira restored her body and revived her damaged spark

events.summary: Nissa's spark fades as part of the Great Desparkening.
events.quote: Nissa's spark faded in the following days as part of the Great Desparkening

events.summary: Chandra competes in the Grand Prix to win the Aetherspark for Nissa so she can return to Zendikar.
events.quote: Chandra competed in an attempt to win the Aetherspark for Nissa, hoping that it would allow her to return to Zendikar.

events.summary: In the Echoverse, Nissa foments an elven rebellion against the kor.
events.quote: Nissa fomented an elven rebellion against the kor.
